desc: positive: Try to flush actions when last one is referenced by filter

match.pattern: (?sm)total acts 1.*action order [0-9]*: gact action drop.*index 3 ref 2 bind 1

pre: ip link add v0p1 type veth peer name v0p0 && ip link set v0p1 up && ip link set v0p0 up
tc qdisc add dev v0p1 ingress
tc actions add action pass index 1
tc actions add action reclassify index 2
tc actions add action drop index 3
tc filter add dev v0p1 protocol all ingress prio 1 handle 0x1234 matchall action gact index 3

pre.cmd: ip link add v0p1 type veth peer name v0p0 && ip link set v0p1 up && ip link set v0p0 up

tc actions add action reclassify index 2
